pinned mathlib source and local immutable history

the already pinned human primary source for unresolved source boundaries

immutable_selection_rules.repo_local: bind results to the repository base revision and tree
immutable_selection_rules.mathlib: use only the lake-manifest pin and its clean checked-out tree; inspect history only when the referenced object is an ancestor of the pin
immutable_selection_rules.external: resolve moving refs to a full commit and tree before candidate classification; bind inspected raw files to that commit and SHA-256
immutable_selection_rules.negative_search: bind dated API responses or explicit access failures to SHA-256; a bounded no-match never proves global absence

credential_policy: Use unauthenticated public read APIs only. Do not expose credentials, clone or fetch dependencies, change Lake inputs, or mutate Formalizations/Lean/.lake. Record HTTP 401/403/429 and search-limit responses rather than bypassing them.
network_policy: Network is permitted only for read-only discovery metadata and immutable raw-source inspection. Candidate elaboration uses the existing local pinned toolchain with network denied.
expected_negative_evidence: HTTP/search status and bounded result count
response-body SHA-256 or explicit local rg exit
access, shard-limit, indexing, archival, and credential limitations
no saturation claim unless independently reviewed
candidate_fields_required: module, file, source hash, declaration, and exact type
toolchain, dependency pins, license, and local dependency feasibility
normalized comparison with the full attainability-plus-upper-bound target
machine-produced axioms and foundation fit where locally checkable
placeholder, bodyless, unsafe, oracle, external-code, and generated-artifact boundary
smallest direct check, M classification, integration blocker, and reopen condition
status_boundary: This protocol freezes a bounded discovery run. Classification of every resulting inventory member does not imply exhaustive global discovery or theorem completion.
